design:
Tier 1: one UI component change, no Hub code, no schema, no migration, no Hub-restart hazard; the bundle refresh reaches :8000 only when the operator merges.

D1. Both behaviours live in AgentTimeline and ConversationControls, not in a new renderer: SharedStreamRenderer is deleted (overhaul-dead-renderers) and AgentTimeline is the one conversation renderer.
D2. 'Live' is the timeline's existing `runVisiblyActive` (AgentTimeline.tsx:203), the same signal the live working indicator uses, so the block is open exactly while the indicator shows and nothing restates the run-settled rules. The live block is the last block of the newest run's turn.
D3. The automatic state is derived on each render, not stored; a block keeps an operator override only after the operator has clicked it, stored per block in the component as its open state is today. Rejected: auto-collapsing even a block the operator opened (the text arriving would shut what they were reading, the complaint a-turn-s-folded-state-is-set-by-the-operator answers for turns). (night-1010-9)
D4. Hidden diagnostics are filtered when the turn's blocks are drawn: a `diagnostic` entry's ResultCard is not rendered; `error` entries are messages and failed tool results are inside work blocks, so both are untouched by construction. Status entries are not diagnostics and stay.
D5. The preference is one browser-wide localStorage value (`aw.conversation.diagnostics.v1`, 'shown' | 'hidden'), read like specPreferences.ts: anything unreadable means shown. Rejected: a per-agent or per-conversation preference (a debugging switch the operator would have to flip in every conversation), and a Hub-stored preference (a route and a column for a display choice). (night-1010-10)
D6. Folding: at the fold, `live-thinking-opens-then-collapses` replaces agent-stream-events `thinking-presentation` (and retires its criterion ac116, whose 'collapsed work block' is now only half the rule); `diagnostics-can-be-hidden` is an addition.
D7. The drive posts the thinking event through POST /agents/{name}/output on a real live Haiku run, because no Claude turn on this machine emits thinking text (non_goals); the route, SSE and rendering it exercises are the ones a Copilot thought chunk takes.

problem: agent-stream-events specified both behaviours and neither was ever built (F572). Today, AgentTimeline.tsx's WorkBlockDisclosure starts every block closed (`useState(false)`, line 538), live or not, so a thinking event never shows while the agent is reasoning. ResultCard (line 831) draws every `diagnostic` entry (entryCategory 'result', agentTimelineModel.ts:9) with no control to hide it; ConversationControls has only 'Fold all turns' (ConversationControls.tsx:112). The earlier presentation lived in SharedStreamRenderer, deleted by f553 (overhaul-dead-renderers), so the capability's current `thinking-presentation` statement describes only the collapsed block, not the live one.

requirements.rationale: overhaul-thinking-ui (F572): the reasoning is worth reading while the agent is still working and is noise once the answer is there; a block that is always closed hides it exactly when it matters.
requirements.statement: Thinking events SHALL be presented as work, not as conversational text. A work block that holds a thinking event SHALL be shown open while it is the last block of the turn whose run is live, and SHALL collapse when a text entry or the run's end follows it; a work block in a turn whose run has ended SHALL render collapsed. Once the operator opens or closes a block themselves, that choice MUST be kept over both rules.

requirements.rationale: overhaul-thinking-ui (F572): diagnostics are for the operator who is debugging a runner, not for one reading the conversation; errors and failed calls are what the reader must never lose.
requirements.statement: The conversation SHALL offer a control that hides diagnostic entries and shows them again. While diagnostics are hidden, error entries and failed tool results MUST remain visible. The choice SHALL persist across reloads in the same browser and default to shown; a stored value that cannot be read SHALL mean shown.

in_scope: AgentTimeline: a work block that holds a thinking event is open while it is the last block of the live turn, and collapses when text or the run's end follows it; an operator's own toggle of that block is kept

ConversationControls: a 'Hide diagnostics' / 'Show diagnostics' control beside 'Fold all turns', kept in localStorage for this browser, default shown; hidden diagnostics leave error entries and failed tool results visible
Vitest for both, and the UI bundle refresh
non_goals: Making the Claude CLI emit thinking text: Claude Code 2.1.291 sends thinking blocks with an empty `thinking` field (signature only, measured 2026-10-10 with MAX_THINKING_TOKENS set), and runner_parsing.py:282-285 drops empty thinking; a Claude conversation therefore shows no thinking whatever this change does
Any Hub route, schema, event kind or migration
Hiding status entries, errors or tool activity
A per-agent or per-conversation diagnostics preference

summary: The conversation shows an agent's reasoning only after the fact: a work block holding thinking starts collapsed, so the operator watching a live turn sees a closed 'Work' line while the agent reasons, and diagnostic cards (model substitutions, adapter notes) sit in every turn with no way to put them away. The operator decided (overhaul-thinking-ui, F572) to build both, as one small UI change in AgentTimeline: the work block the agent is reasoning in stays open while the run is live and collapses when its answer arrives, and a conversation control hides diagnostics while errors and failed calls stay visible.
